title: Community Rules for Animals — Pet Addendum Amenity Access and Visiting Animals
content:
Under each type of Pet Addendum the community sets whether the animal must be leashed or carried in common areas, which shared spaces it may use, and whether a visiting animal of the same type may stay.

| Addendum type | Leashed or carried in common areas | Common areas other than dedicated pet areas | Community dog park | Pet wash station | Visiting animal of the same type may stay | Days a visiting animal may stay |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Assistance Animal Accommodation | Required | Permitted | Permitted | Permitted | No | 0 |
| Caged Pet Addendum | Not required | Not permitted | Not permitted | Not permitted | No | 0 |
| Cat Addendum | Required | Not permitted | Not permitted | Permitted | No | 0 |
| Small Dog Addendum (under 25 lb) | Required | Permitted | Permitted | Permitted | Yes | 7 |
| Medium Dog Addendum (25-49 lb) | Required | Permitted | Permitted | Permitted | Yes | 7 |
| Large Dog Addendum (50-90 lb) | Required | Permitted | Permitted | Permitted | No | 0 |

**Leashed or carried** — whether the animal must be leashed or carried in common areas.
**Common areas other than dedicated pet areas** — whether the animal may use the community's common areas beyond the areas set aside for pets.
**Community dog park** and **pet wash station** — whether the animal may use each of these.
**Visiting animal** — whether a visiting animal of the same type may stay, and for how many days.

### Points of comparison

- Visiting animals may stay only under the Small Dog Addendum (under 25 lb) and the Medium Dog Addendum (25-49 lb), for up to 7 days. For the other four types the column reads "No" and the day count is 0.
- A Cat Addendum animal may use the pet wash station but not the dog park or the common areas beyond dedicated pet areas.
- A Caged Pet Addendum animal has no leash requirement and none of the listed amenities.
- The Assistance Animal Accommodation carries the same leash requirement and the same amenity access as the Small Dog Addendum (under 25 lb), but no visiting-animal allowance.
